//: Bundled rhythm + picking pattern library for the Patterns screen. Each pattern is a short .alphatex file that loops by default — practice the groove rather than the tune. Same format as assets/examples/manifest.json. Grouped here so the GUI can render a tree-of-difficulty browser; CLI users can play these directly via `twanga play assets/patterns/<file>.alphatex --loop`.

groups.title: Clawhammer (banjo)
groups.description: Old-time banjo rhythmic patterns built around the bum-diddy figure: melody note + brush + drone-string pluck.

groups.title: Bluegrass picking (banjo)
groups.description: Three-finger picking patterns. Loop them under tempo to lock in the muscle memory before applying them to a melody.

groups.title: Ukulele strums
groups.description: Simple strumming patterns. The chord shape is C major (all open strings) so you can hold one shape and focus on the rhythm.

groups.title: Guitar (standard tuning)
groups.description: Open-G chord shape drills. Hold the G shape (3 2 0 0 0 3 low → high) — both entries below share that fretting so muscle memory transfers between them; the drill is the picking/strumming pattern itself.
